description: This file contains the implementation of an Instancemanager component for Android Cuttlefish, including functions for managing CVD instances, fetching artifacts, validating host environment, and creating and manipulating directories.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Interface for validating host environment for CVD operation.

classes.name: EmptyFieldError
classes.description: Custom error type indicating an empty required field.

classes.name: AndroidBuild
classes.description: Represents an Android build with ID and target.

classes.name: IMPaths
classes.description: Contains paths related to instance manager artifacts.

classes.name: fetchCVDCommandArtifactsFetcher
classes.description: Fetches CVD command artifacts, holding execution context and credentials.

classes.name: buildAPIArtifactsFetcher
classes.description: Fetches build artifacts using provided BuildAPI.

classes.name: startCVDParams
classes.description: Parameters used for creating and starting a CVD instance.

classes.name: HostValidator
classes.description: Validates the host environment, e.g., checking for /dev/kvm.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the host environment for running CVDs.

methods.name: CvdGroupToAPIObject
methods.description: Converts a cvd.Group to its API representation.

methods.name: CvdInstanceToAPIObject
methods.description: Converts a cvd.Instance to its API representation.

methods.name: findGroup
methods.description: Finds a group by name within a fleet.

methods.name: findInstance
methods.description: Finds an instance by name within a group.

methods.name: CVDLogsDir
methods.description: Retrieves the logs directory path for a specific CVD instance.

methods.name: CreateCVD
methods.description: Creates and starts a new CVD group based on given parameters.

methods.name: updateBuildsWithLatestGreenBuildID
methods.description: Updates a list of builds with the latest green build ID if missing.

methods.name: updateBuildWithLatestGreenBuildID
methods.description: Updates a specific build with the latest green build ID.

methods.name: downloadArtifactToFile
methods.description: Downloads an artifact to a file, handling existing file checks.
